title: 국제민사사법공조규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00007:part:1/1

Article 7 (Disbursement of Expenses and Claims for Reimbursement)
(1) Where expenses are incurred in executing a request, the requested court shall disburse them against an advance payment from the National Treasury: Provided, That fees and other expenses payable to an enforcement officer may be collected from a foreign institution and paid to the enforcement officer. <Amended on June 28, 2002>
(2) In cases under paragraph (1), the head of the requested court shall forward the statement of expenses and a notice of payment prepared by the court's officer responsible for claims management, or a claim prepared by the enforcement officer, to the Director General of the National Court Administration together with the documents reporting the execution of the request under Article 16 (1) of the Act. <Amended on June 28, 2002>
(3) The Director General of the National Court Administration shall forward the statement of expenses and notice of payment or the claim under paragraph (2) to the Minister of Foreign Affairs and Trade, and request that the Minister arrange for the relevant expenses to be paid to the requested court. <Amended on June 28, 2002>
